summary: Tested PortalDealDetail page complete mobile-first redesign. All 11 features verified working correctly at both mobile (390x844) and desktop (1920x800) viewports.

title_address_first.details: Property title '5129 West Avenue' and address are the FIRST visible content on page (Y position 110.5px), above photo carousel (Y position 241px)

photo_separate_from_agent.details: Photo carousel is separate from agent contact - agent section is BELOW photo (Y position 523px), not side-by-side

agent_standalone_card.details: Agent/Contact section is its own standalone card with 'Listing Agent' title, avatar, name (Pedro Ramirez), company (NextSite), Call and Email Agent buttons

notes_always_visible.details: Notes section ALWAYS visible even when empty - shows 'No notes for this property' message with StickyNote icon

documents_always_visible.details: Documents section ALWAYS visible even when empty - shows 'No documents available' message with FileText icon

unified_overview_grid.details: Property Overview grid shows unified facts (financial + physical merged): Asking Price, Building Size, Lot Size, Land SQFT, Zoning, Cap Rate, NOI, Annual Expenses, Price/SF (9 cells total)

consistent_card_styling.details: All 5 sections use consistent pdp-card styling with 12px border-radius, same border and background colors

mobile_layout.details: Mobile (390px): 2-column overview grid (177.5px x 177.5px), stacked vertical sections, proper 16px padding

desktop_layout.details: Desktop (1920px): 1100px max-width container, 4-column overview grid (261.75px each), 440px photo height, 32px title font size, 380px map height

save_unsave_toggle.details: Save/Unsave toggle works - button text changes between 'Save' and 'Saved' with heart icon fill change

location_map_marker.details: Location map renders with OpenStreetMap tiles and teardrop marker (maplibregl-marker) at property coordinates

critical_code_review_comments: Clean CSS-based responsive design with media queries at 640px and 1024px breakpoints

All data-testid attributes present for testing: title-block, property-title, photo-carousel, hero-property-image, agent-section, section-overview, section-notes, section-documents, section-location, back-to-map, detail-save-btn, contact-agent-btn, agent-phone
Mobile-first approach with proper touch targets and -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch for smooth scrolling
Consistent card styling using pdp-card class across all sections
context_for_next_testing_agent: PortalDealDetail page completely redesigned with mobile-first CSS classes and media queries. Title/address now FIRST (above photo), agent section is SEPARATE card below photo, Notes and Documents sections ALWAYS visible with empty states. Responsive grid: 2-col mobile, 3-col tablet, 4-col desktop. Scrollable container uses .pdp-root class. Session token must be set in localStorage as portal_session_{portalId} before accessing.
